body:
👁️ About Human Dimension
Human Dimension is a dark, biological horror-themed mod that introduces a grotesque and unsettling new reality to Minecraft. Traveling to this terrifying dimension is an adventure in itself: you must collect meat from the Overworld to build a fleshy portal frame, and then craft a specialized portal key using more collected meat to open the gateway.

🧠 Key Features & Mechanics
The Flesh & Bone Biome: Explore a deeply unsettling environment made of organic tissues, filled with custom structures, dark atmosphere, and unique resources.

Brain Structures & Genetics: Discover massive, brain-like structures within the biome. Harvest Neurons from these structures and convert them into DNA to produce spawn eggs for passive animals like sheep and cows!

Camouflaged Predators: Watch your step! The dimension is incredibly dark, and the horrifying creatures that dwell here are perfectly camouflaged within the dimensional blocks, waiting to ambush unprepared players.

New Progression: Complete with its own unique structures, custom mobs, items, and specialized armor sets crafted from organic matter.

🎮 How It Changes Your Experience
A Psychological Horror Vibe: The darkness and camouflage mechanics force players to move slowly, use torches, and constantly stay on high alert.

A Unique Automation/Farming Route: The ability to turn harvested brains/neurons into animal DNA completely alters how you handle late-game animal farming and resource gathering.

Note: This mod is still under development. I would highly appreciate it if you could report any bugs or issues you encounter!
